mapper.select: SELECT ShopName FROM shopwizard.tCmpShop WHERE ShopCode = #{shopCode}

SELECT OP.OrderNo AS orderNo, OP.OrderProdNo AS orderProdNo, IFNULL(OP.ProdName, '') AS prodName, IFNULL(OP.ItemName, '') AS itemName FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON O.OrderNo = OP.OrderNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON Ch.ChnlCode = O.ChnlCode WHERE OP.OrderState = '지불완료' AND (OP.ShopCode IS NULL OR OP.ShopCode = '') AND Ch.SvcCode = (SELECT SvcCode FROM shopwizard.tCmpShop WHERE ShopCode = #{shopCode}) AND O.ChnlCode <> #{ownMallChnlCode} ORDER BY OP.OrderNo, OP.OrderProdNo
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tOrdOrderProd SET ShopCode = #{shopCode}, ShopName = #{shopName}, ChangeId = #{actorId}, ChangeName = #{actorName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND OrderState = '지불완료' AND (ShopCode IS NULL OR ShopCode = '')
